title: Alex Eala among 4 players featured in Prudential Hong Kong Open promotional launch
summary: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala is one of the four players featured in the promotional launch of the Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open, a WTA 250 event set for November 2 to 8.
